failure_cases.question: independent[10]
failure_cases.text: Welche Termine nennen die erste Planung und die spätere Änderungsnotiz zur Epsilon-Abnahme jeweils?
failure_cases.source: RCS05 gives May 12 at 09:00; RCS06 says it was moved to May 19 at 14:30 and replaced the old date.
failure_cases.observation: Only the original May 12 date is displayed; the latest date and the fact that the old date is replaced are omitted. The correct later date was drafted but rejected because the candidate called the source's update a Änderungsnotiz, while the source says Aktualisierung and its title says Terminänderung. The surviving answer risks leaving a stale date salient.

rejected_but_supported_drafts.question: original[29]
rejected_but_supported_drafts.claim: Für den Stand auf der Ausstellung stehen 12.000 Euro zur Verfügung.
rejected_but_supported_drafts.reason_recorded: The term Ausstellung was not in the source.
rejected_but_supported_drafts.assessment: The short draft omits the source condition that the 12,000 euro Messe budget includes travel costs, a material planning caveat for a stand-only budget. The displayed quote fallback includes "Reisekosten eingeschlossen", so this is not an omission in the final displayed answer and not a false claim.

properly_rejected_or_cautioned: original[0,1,13,21,22,23] and independent[9,14]: candidate added a calendar year/date absent from the source; the displayed source wording preserves only the supported relative or month/day time.
original[20]: 'ab 10 Uhr' is not equivalent to 'erst nach 10 Uhr'; the quote fallback preserves the stricter boundary.
original[12]: the weekday exists in the source but its source date is unknown; asking for the date anchor is appropriate.

displayed_quotes.assessment: All quote fallbacks inspected are source-faithful and none contains a materially unrelated quotation. Some include adjacent context, such as the move's box-delivery date, but it is from the same relevant source. In original[29], the displayed quote retains the travel-cost inclusion caveat omitted by the rejected short draft; no wrong displayed claim was identified.
displayed_quotes.caveat: Quote fallbacks often still answer the question, so a rejected free-sentence draft is not automatically a user-facing refusal.

practical_conclusion: The accepted free sentences were accurate in these synthetic samples (35/35), but that does not validate the same-model verifier. The visible risk is answer coverage: the original trace shows retrieval misses, selection losses, and a selected-source display refusal on known facts; the independent run shows false verifier rejections of supported material conditions, leaving incomplete answers including one that foregrounds a superseded date. The rejected original[29] short draft also omitted travel-cost inclusion, although the displayed source quote retained it. This content review predates the transport-deadline change and says nothing about its effect on answer quality.
